title: The Best Z-Wave Thermostats
subtitle: Every Z-Wave thermostat we found on Amazon, ranked.
intro: Z-Wave thermostats are rare now; most makers moved to Wi-Fi. We scored the ones on Amazon on rating, review volume, and features. Two are built mainly for security panels.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

buyers_guide.a: Most smart thermostats need constant power from a C (common) wire. Some include a power adapter for homes without one, and a few run on batteries. Check your current thermostat's wiring before you buy.

buyers_guide.q: Will it work with my heating and cooling system?
buyers_guide.a: Most smart thermostats handle standard 24 V forced-air and heat pump systems. Line-voltage electric baseboard heaters need a different, line-voltage thermostat. Check the maker's compatibility checker before buying.
If some rooms run hotter or colder than where the thermostat hangs, yes. Remote room sensors let the thermostat average temperatures or focus on the rooms you're using.
